title: International Conference on Neuromorphic Computing and Engineering (ICNCE) 2026
summary: The International Conference on Neuromorphic Computing and Engineering is scheduled for June 28 to July 2, 2026 in Aachen, Germany. The event focuses on interdisciplinary research linking neuroscience, microelectronics, computer science, and AI. Honorary Chair Rainer Waser represents RWTH Aachen University and Forschungszentrum Jülich GmbH. Co-Chairs include Regina Dittmann (Electronic Materials), Bastian Leibe (Computer Vision), Abigail Morrison (Computation in Neural Circuits), Emre Neftci (Neuromorphic Software Ecosystems), and John Paul Strachan (Neuromorphic Compute Nodes). All co-chairs are affiliated with Forschungszentrum Jülich GmbH, RWTH Aachen University, or AMO GmbH. The conference aims to foster collaboration across these specific neuromorphic engineering domains.
tldr: ICNCE 2026 is a planned interdisciplinary event in Germany focusing on neuroscience and microelectronics integration for AI applications from June 28 to July 2, 2026.
